name: HABU
long_description:
HABU is an AI-native real estate development firm that helps real estate investors deploy capital to build housing faster, at lower cost, and with higher yield. 

We're building an internal AI-native operating system that completes 90%+ of development tasks at 95% faster processing speeds while delivering the same outcomes customers expect externally: high yield, low risk projects. We're selling the outcome, not the inputs to the outcome. 

Developers are service providers for white-collar investors: they find land, construct buildings, and operate and sell them for a profit. Our customers don't care how the projects are sourced or managed, only that they are completed on time and produce the forecasted returns. 

We use agentic workflows, geospatial analysis and mapping, and development-specific workflow automation to manage the end-to-end process. The result is 5x more projects per FTE compared to a non-AI developer, 20% faster project schedules, and 10-15% lower total project costs. 

We're *not* long term property owners, strictly the service provider (fee/merchant developer).

$160B was deployed into multifamily in 2025 and $534B into commercial real estate overall. Developers naturally have high operating margins and we are building to be the most operationally and capital efficient developer in the country. 

Starting first with multifamily in Phoenix and then expanding nationally.

launches.title: HABU - The AI-Native Real Estate Developer
launches.tagline: We build apartment buildings 20% faster and 15% cheaper by running the entire development process on AI
launches.body:
Hello, World 👋 We're **Bryan** and **Jun**, co-founders of **HABU**.

**TL;DR:** HABU is an AI-native real estate development firm that helps real estate investors deploy capital to build housing faster, at lower cost, and with higher yield. 

Institutional Investors (investment firms, family offices, high-net-worth individuals) hire us to find land, construct an apartment building, operate it and then sell it. Every step of that process runs on an AI operating system we built ourselves instead of the legacy process of Excel files, PDFs, emails, and a surprisingly high amount of manual knowledge work that the rest of the industry still uses.

We are **the developer**. Not a SaaS product. The actual developer. We work for institutional investors to go build physical assets and we get paid to do it on their behalf.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DKP0P6RK9X4>

**🏗️ What a developer actually does**

Real estate development has historically been an opaque industry and generally not well understood. Here’s how it works. White-collar investors like investment funds, private equity, family offices, etc., deploy about **$160B a year** into multifamily projects. They can either buy one that already operates (—> call a broker) or build a new one from the ground up (—> call a developer). A developer finds the land, gets the permits, hires the architect and builder, manages construction, and delivers a finished building.

That’s where we fit in. HABU is not a software product for developers. **We are the developer.** 

**❌ The Problem**

New housing has never been slower or more expensive to build. The high cost of new housing increases everyone's cost of living while also making it hard to finance a project. 

A single apartment project involves 700+ discrete internal tasks and over 1,000+ hours of manual desk work: pulling data from a dozen public databases by hand, calling brokers, architects, engineers, and lawyers for quotes, and tracking it all in spreadsheets, word docs, and even physical paper.  

The biggest technological jump for commercial real estate over the past 40 years was Excel. Seriously, Excel! 

**🤖 How HABU works**

We built an internal AI-native operating system that completes projects up to 10-20% faster, lowers total project costs by 10-15%, and lets us manage 5x more projects per development manager. The end-to-end process is automated and autonomously ran:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=117228&key=user_uploads/1280882/4abab095-10ec-442f-8d93-b2fd3cd8bfbb)

**💵 We are not long term property owners**. Just the service provider. That keeps us extremely capital light, operationally efficient, and lets us scale in a way that legacy developers could never do.

**👫 The Team**

**Bryan**- worked on $310M+ of projects (industrial, datacenter land, and mostly multifamily). Top-ranked grad in the Master’s of Real Estate Development (MRED) program at ASU. Long career in sales leadership at VC-backed startups like Mutiny: employee #5, raised $75M from YC, Sequoia, Insight, Tiger Global, Cowboy Ventures, Uncork, etc. Started first company at age 23 redeveloping brownfield sites and environmental remediation. Double-undergrad of Economics and Sustainability. \
**Jun**  spent 4.5 years at Meta building AI data systems used across global operations and product teams. Previously managed aviation logistics and complex supply chains in the U.S. Navy and led enterprise transformation work at Accenture. Technical builder with experience taking AI products from 0 to production. M.S. in Analytics. Immigrant, Navy veteran, and first gen college graduate.

**🙏 Our Ask**

* Know an investment firm, family office, or high-net-worth individual (founders, VCs, executives) looking to invest in real estate? Introduce us.
* Own land in Phoenix? Let's talk.
* Interested in working for HABU and building the future of buildings? Hit up Bryan or Jun!

👉 [www.buildhabu.com](http://www.buildhabu.com)
